question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer for blank number 3 is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In English, when referring to a specific date, the preposition **"on"** is commonly used.
 
• The **sentence is discussing** a declaration made on a particular date, September 11, 1893, so **"on" **is the appropriate preposition to use in this context.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"I am proud to belong to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance and universal acceptance," he declared **on **September 11, 1893. "We believe not only in universal toleration, (4) __________ we accept all religions as true. I am proud to belong to a nation which has sheltered the persecuted and the (5) _________ of all religions and all nations of the earth."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"upon" **is not used with dates and doesn't fit grammatically here.
 
• Option 2 **"in"** would be used to refer to a broader time frame, such as a month or a year, but not a specific date.
 
• Option 4 **"at"** is also not suitable here as it's more commonly used with specific times of the day, rather than dates.
